note: Set B binds values to the correct elevations more often and captures the drawing scales for South Bedroom, North Bedroom and North Living plus the West Living MWL01 and 3'-9 11/16" segments with fewer invented bindings. Set A repeatedly attaches overall elevation heights to panel/label entities (W1 width 9'-11 1/4", "height P1" 9'-10 1/4", MWL01 width 3'-9 11/16", D1 width 3'-6"), puts 7'-6" on North Bedroom when that dimension sits in the West Bedroom (A3) block, and claims WB in the East Bedroom elevation where no WB appears. Set B's main faults are duplication (3'-9 11/16", the 1/2"=1'-0" scale and 9'-11 1/2" each stated twice), the misbound 1'-5 3/4" to North Living (it is in North Bedroom C5) and an unsupported P3 height of 7'-2 1/2". Both sets leave many dimensions under vague entities such as "interior elevation", "component" or "wall section" and omit a number of dimensions present on the sheet.
remarks: The text layer runs in drawing order C1 North Living, C3 West Living, C5 North Bedroom, A1 South Bedroom, A3 West Bedroom, A5 East Bedroom; several of A's errors come from reading a dimension out of its block (7'-6" and 3'-6" belong to A3/A1 respectively, not to North Bedroom or D1). Both sets use bare dimension strings as quotes, so quotes give little evidence of which dimension line a value came from. Facts both sets miss include 13'-3 3/4", 2'-9 1/8", 9'-2 3/4", 3'-6 1/4", 7", 4 1/2", 9'-1 7/8", 8'-8 3/8", 9'-10", the F1/F2 and TV labels, D3 and P4; the artwork note explicitly defers size to the artwork package, so A's "artwork height 4'-3"" is unsupported.
